name: jobra
description: Create evidence-backed candidate profiles with human review, discover sourced job opportunities, and produce explainable candidate–opportunity assessments with reviewable results. Jobra never submits applications; matching quality has not been independently established.

interface.longDescription: Build and review an evidence-backed candidate profile, research sourced job postings, and inspect explainable candidate–opportunity assessments. Matching quality has not been independently established. Jobra never submits applications.
